source_quote: I think the `adapt_patch` will just do once in platform, why we need this const value to early exit the patch? It makes the code more complex.

rule.description: 在 vLLM-Ascend 的 platform patch 机制中，`adapt_patch` 通过 Python 模块缓存只导入一次。因此不需要使用 `_PATCHED_*` 常量属性做提前退出守卫。这种防御性编程会增加代码复杂度而没有实际收益。
checkpoints: 检查 patch 模块中是否存在 `_PATCHED_*` 提前退出属性
确认 `adapt_patch` 路径是否已通过模块缓存保证单次执行
区分 `_PATCHED_*`（不必要）和 `_ORIGINAL_*`（必要，保存原始方法）属性

diff.unified:
--- a/vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_structured_output.py
+++ b/vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_structured_output.py
@@ -1,11 +1,11 @@
 def _patch_structured_outputs_config():
-    """Patch StructuredOutputsConfig to guard mixed backends."""
-    if getattr(StructuredOutputsConfig,
-               "_PATCHED_BACKEND_GUARD", False):
-        return
-    setattr(StructuredOutputsConfig,
-            "_PATCHED_BACKEND_GUARD", True)
+    """Patch StructuredOutputsConfig to guard mixed backends.
 
+    adapt_patch in platform ensures this module is imported only
+    once via Python module caching, so no _PATCHED_* early-exit
+    guard is needed. _ORIGINAL_* attributes are preserved for
+    delegation and test inspection.
+    """
     _original_validate = StructuredOutputsConfig.validate
 
     @functools.wraps(_original_validate)
@@ -22,12 +22,6 @@
 
 def _patch_grammar_init():
     """Patch StructuredOutputManager.grammar_init for mixed backends."""
-    if getattr(StructuredOutputManager,
-               "_PATCHED_GRAMMAR_GUARD", False):
-        return
-    setattr(StructuredOutputManager,
-            "_PATCHED_GRAMMAR_GUARD", True)
-
     _original_grammar_init = StructuredOutputManager.grammar_init
 
     @functools.wraps(_original_grammar_init)
